attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Fixes pagination offset/count bug in taxonomy term listing driver, a small and well-scoped change limited to the Taxonomies module, but changes query behavior (Skip/Take instead of Take(n+1)) so subtle off-by-one or performance regressions in existing tenants relying on prior pagination quirks are possible."}

reason: Fixes pagination offset/count bug in taxonomy term listing driver, a small and well-scoped change limited to the Taxonomies module, but changes query behavior (Skip/Take instead of Take(n+1)) so subtle off-by-one or performance regressions in existing tenants relying on prior pagination quirks are possible.
